presentation.scope: Actual Main submitted overlay state at pre-draw. task_completion_registration.mechanism: The present PersistentWorkerPool lends a dispatch context to every awakened worker and therefore must wait for every configured worker, including workers which claim no task. The new default-off path claims a task and its current context together under the existing pool mutex; only actual task borrowers may access the context. The caller waits for every real task to return and reacquires that same mutex before retiring context. A late idle worker may only claim a task from the currently published dispatch. No task, phase, physical step or required material evolution is removed.
